content: If the BswMDevErrorDetect switch is enabled, BswM_modeNotificationPort shall check if the BSW Mode Manager is initialized. In case of an error, the BswM shall ignore the notification and report the error to the Default Error Tracer with the error code BSWM_E_UNINIT
